title: Count unique visitors
prompt: Write `public static int UniqueVisitors(List<string> visitors)`. The list has one name per visit, and an empty string means the visitor gave no name. Return how many different named visitors there are. Do not count the empty string.
hints: Which collection keeps each value only once?
Decide what to do with an empty string before adding a name.
Add every name that is not "" to a HashSet<string>, then return its Count.
checkLabels: Ana, Ben and Ana are 2 different visitors.
The same visitor twice counts once.
Visits with no name must not be counted.
A list of only unowned visit has 0 visitors.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts visits instead of different visitors.
Counts the empty string as an visitor.

feedback: Check a list with a repeated name, then a list with an empty string in it. Repeats count once and the empty string is not an visitor.
